description: Declarative golden evaluation test specifications for VPN troubleshooting multi-turn voice conversations.

expected_properties.behavior: Acknowledge issue and prompt for missing diagnostic context (location, client, or internet status).

dialogue.text: Estoy en Perú, tengo FortiClient y sí tengo internet.

expected_properties.behavior: Consume all facts in a single inference without asking redundant questions about location, client, or internet.

dialogue.text: ¿Qué cliente de VPN tienes instalado en tu equipo?

expected_properties.behavior: Explain the technical term 'cliente' naturally as software/program (e.g. FortiClient, Cisco), preserve context, and do not mechanically repeat the previous question.

dialogue.text: Estoy en Perú y uso FortiClient.
Entendido, estás en Perú con FortiClient. ¿Tienes conexión a internet?
Perdón, no estoy en Perú. Estoy en Chile.

expected_properties.behavior: Seamlessly update the location to Chile without losing previously confirmed facts (FortiClient) or restarting the protocol.

dialogue.text: No sé qué es gateway ni qué significa puerto 443.

expected_properties.behavior: Explain gateway and port 443 in simple, non-jargon spoken Spanish tailored for telephony audio pacing.
